q1.explanationZh: influence“影响”加 -ial 构成形容词 influential“有影响的”。

q2.explanationZh: inform“通知，告知”，常用 inform sb. of/about sth.。

q3.explanationZh: formal“正式的”前加否定前缀 in- 构成 informal“非正式的”。

q4.explanationZh: inform 的名词 information“消息；资料”，不可数名词，没有复数。

q5.explanationZh: inform 加 -ative 构成形容词 informative“提供消息的；有教益的”。

q6.explanationZh: ingredient“成分；（烹调的）原料”，注意拼写 -ient 结尾。

q7.explanationZh: inhabit“居住在”加 -ant 表示人，inhabitant“居民”。

q8.explanationZh: inherit“继承”，如 inherit the title“继承爵位”。

q9.explanationZh: initial 作形容词“最初的”，作名词“首字母”。

q10.explanationZh: initiate“发起；开始实施”，注意与 initial、initiative 区分。

q11.explanationZh: initiative 是名词“主动性；首创精神”，take the initiative“采取主动”。

q13.explanationZh: injure 是动词“伤害”，被伤害用 be injured。

q14.explanationZh: injure 的名词 injury“伤害；受伤处”，复数 injuries。

q15.explanationZh: ink“墨水”，in red ink“用红墨水”。

q16.explanationZh: inn“小旅馆，客栈”，注意是两个 n。

q17.explanationZh: inner 作形容词“内部的；内心的”，也可作名词“内部”。

q18.explanationZh: innocent“清白的；无罪的”，be innocent of a crime“无罪”。

q19.explanationZh: innovation“革新；创新”，形容词是 innovative。

q20.explanationZh: input 作名词“投入”，作动词“输入”，与 output“产出”相对。

q21.explanationZh: inquire 也拼作 enquire，“询问，打听”，inquire about sth.“打听某事”。

q22.explanationZh: inquire 的名词 inquiry（也拼作 enquiry），“询问”。

q24.explanationZh: insert“插入”，insert A between B and C“把 A 插在 B 和 C 之间”。

q25.explanationZh: inside 作介词“在……里面”，反义词 outside。

q26.explanationZh: insight“洞察力”，由 in + sight（看）构成，“看到里面”。

q27.explanationZh: insist“坚持；坚决认为”，常用 insist on/upon 和 insist that ...。

q29.explanationZh: inspect 加 -ion 构成名词 inspection“视察；检查”。

q30.explanationZh: inspire“鼓舞；给……以灵感”，名词是 inspiration“灵感”。

q31.explanationZh: instal(l)“安装”，英式可拼作 instal，常见拼法是 install。

q33.explanationZh: instant 作名词“瞬间”，作形容词“即刻的；速溶的”，如 instant coffee。

q34.explanationZh: instead 是副词“作为替代；反而”，instead of 后接名词、代词或动名词。

q35.explanationZh: inquire about sth./sb.“打听某事／某人”，介词用 about。

q36.explanationZh: inquire after sb.“问候某人”，介词用 after。

q37.explanationZh: inquire into“调查；追究”，介词用 into，表示“深入了解”。

q38.explanationZh: inject sth. into sth.“把……注射（注入）到……”。

q39.explanationZh: make inquiries“查询；调查”，inquiry 用复数 inquiries。

q40.explanationZh: insist on/upon“坚持；一定要”，on 后接名词或动名词。

q41.explanationZh: insist that ... 表示“坚持要……”时，从句用（should）+ 动词原形的虚拟语气。

q42.explanationZh: inspire sb. to do sth.“鼓励（激励）某人做某事”，to 后接动词原形。

q44.explanationZh: instead of“代替；而不”，后接名词、代词或动名词。

q45.explanationZh: in place of“代替”，后面只能接名词或代词。

q46.explanationZh: input sth. into“把……投入（输入）到……”。

q47.explanationZh: be innocent of a crime“无罪”，innocent 后用介词 of。

q48.explanationZh: in an instant“一刹那”，instant 以元音音素开头，用冠词 an。

q49.explanationZh: inner emotions“内心感情”，inner 作定语修饰名词。

q50.explanationZh: “长子将继承爵位”，inherit“继承”，will 后用动词原形。

q51.explanationZh: “不要用红墨水写练习”，in red ink“用红墨水”。

q52.explanationZh: “他们输入了 3000 个词”，input 的过去式 inputted（也可用 input）。

q53.explanationZh: “总理对越南作了一次非正式访问”，an 后修饰名词 visit 用形容词 informal。

q54.explanationZh: “我们坚持自力更生”，insist on/upon“坚持”，主语 We 用原形。

q55.explanationZh: “他在两页纸中间夹了一张复写纸”，insert“插入”，叙述过去的事用过去式 inserted。

q56.explanationZh: “他毫不费劲地在网上找到了所需的资料”，the 后用名词 information，不可数。

q57.explanationZh: “这个小区有多少居民”，How many 后接可数名词复数 inhabitants。

q58.explanationZh: “有多达 3 万人在交通事故中受伤”，have been + 过去分词构成被动，用 injured。

q59.explanationZh: “最好不要打听女性的年龄和私事”，not to 后用动词原形，inquire about“打听”。

q60.sampleAnswer: The restaurant manager insists that large-scale production becomes meaningful only when the public truly understands seaweed and is willing to accept it as a food source.
references: The restaurant manager insists that large-scale production becomes meaningful only when the public truly understands seaweed and is willing to accept it as a food source.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “坚持认为”表示看法时 insist that 从句用陈述语气；“只有当……时”= only when ...。

q61.sampleAnswer: He is a man of great initiative.
references: He is a man of great initiative.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “进取心很强的人”= a man of great initiative，“of + 抽象名词”作定语。

q62.sampleAnswer: Stay calm at all times instead of taking blind action.
references: Stay calm at all times instead of taking blind action.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “而非……”= instead of，of 后接动名词 taking；“任何时候”= at all times。

q63.sampleAnswer: The newly launched policies have created numerous job opportunities, attracting more young talents to settle down in this area and injecting energy into the local enterprises.
references: The newly launched policies have created numerous job opportunities, attracting more young talents to settle down in this area and injecting energy into the local enterprises.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “新出台的政策”= the newly launched policies；“为……注入活力”= inject energy/vitality into ...；后两个动作用现在分词 attracting、injecting 作结果状语。原书答案印作 The new-launched policies（不规范），经人工复核（GitHub #136）更正为 The newly launched policies。

q64.sampleAnswer: In the age of global competition, design innovation is vital.
references: In the age of global competition, design innovation is vital.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “设计创新”= design innovation；“至关重要”= vital。

q65.sampleAnswer: No matter how hard he tried to defend himself, he couldn’t persuade the people present to believe that he was innocent.
references: No matter how hard he tried to defend himself, he couldn’t persuade the people present to believe that he was innocent.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “不管怎么……”= no matter how；“无辜的”= innocent；“在场的人”= the people present。

q66.sampleAnswer: Our monitor’s being praised and awarded greatly inspired all the students in our class.
references: Our monitor’s being praised and awarded greatly inspired all the students in our class.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: 用动名词复合结构 Our monitor’s being praised and awarded 作主语；“鼓舞”= inspire，用过去式 inspired。原书答案句首印作 Monitor’s（缺 Our），经人工复核（GitHub #136）按手册例句更正为 Our monitor’s。

q67.sampleAnswer: Not discouraged by his failure, he persevered in his research.
references: Not discouraged by his failure, he persevered in his research.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “坚持做（研究）”= persevere in，指不顾困难坚持到底；Not discouraged by ... 是过去分词短语作状语。

q68.sampleAnswer: If you listen to the radio every day, you will be informed of what is happening in different places of the world.
references: If you listen to the radio every day, you will be informed of what is happening in different places of the world.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “了解某事”= be informed of sth.，of 后接 what 引导的宾语从句。

q69.sampleAnswer: The government has taken a series of measures to deal with environmental pollution recently, and these measures have achieved initial effects in some cities.
references: The government has taken a series of measures to deal with environmental pollution recently, and these measures have achieved initial effects in some cities.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: “初步成效”= initial effects；“采取措施”= take measures，“治理”= deal with。
